trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Customer introduces themselves and mentions a previous interaction.
steps.text: Hello, இது LD-1002. நான் நேத்து call பண்ணேன்.

steps.purpose: Agent greets the customer and offers assistance.
steps.text: வணக்கம். நான் உங்களுக்கு எப்படி உதவி செய்ய முடியும்?

steps.purpose: Customer expresses time pressure and asks for the cheapest 3BHK in a specific project.
steps.text: எனக்கு time ரொம்ப கம்மி. உங்க Hinjewadi project ல cheapest 3BHK எவ்வளோ னு சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Agent initiates identity verification before disclosing any information.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must not disclose any account-specific details until identity is verified.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. உங்க details share பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி, account verification காக உங்க registered name மற்றும் pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must complete identity verification before discussing lead's specific budget or details.

steps.purpose: Customer hastily provides verification details.
steps.text: என் name Ramesh, pincode 411057. சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க, எனக்கு ஒரு meeting இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the verification outcome.
Retrieve the lead's budget and configuration preferences.
Return the lead's profile details.
Agent acknowledges successful verification and confirms the lead's budget.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent proceeds with the flow only after successful verification and grounds the budget on the tool result.
steps.text: நன்றி Ramesh. உங்க identity verify ஆகிடுச்சு. உங்க profile படி உங்க budget 60 lakhs னு இருக்கு. நான் Hinjewadi project inventory check பண்ணவா?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent acknowledges verification and uses the retrieved lead budget to confirm the customer's requirement.

steps.purpose: Customer confirms the budget and urges the agent to check quickly.
steps.text: ஆமா, 60 lakhs தான். சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணி சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for 3BHK units in the Hinjewadi project.
Return the available inventory showing prices above the customer's budget.
Agent discloses the RERA ID and the cheapest available unit price, which is above budget.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must disclose the RERA ID and quote the exact price from the tool result.
steps.text: Ramesh, Hinjewadi project ஓட RERA ID P52100001234. இப்போ இருக்க inventory படி, cheapest 3BHK price 75 lakhs.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent quotes the exact price and RERA ID returned by the inventory tool without any modifications.

steps.purpose: Customer complains about the price and asks for a discount, with an STT error on the word for 'too much'.

steps.purpose: Customer asks about the possession timeline.
steps.text: அப்போ possession எப்போ கிடைக்கும்? அதுவாது சீக்கிரம் வருமா?

steps.purpose: Agent states the exact possession quarter from the tool result.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must state possession exactly as the quarter returned by the tool.
steps.text: இந்த 3BHK unit ஓட possession Q4 2025 ல கிடைக்கும். இதுவும் system ல இருக்க details தான்.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent states the possession quarter exactly as returned by the tool without making forward guarantees.

steps.purpose: Customer complains about the timeline and asks for investment advice.
steps.text: Q4 2025 ஆ? அது ரொம்ப late. எனக்கு investment காக தான் வேணும். இது நல்ல investment ஆ இருக்குமா?

steps.purpose: Agent refuses to provide investment advice per business rules.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must decline to advise on investment merit.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும் Ramesh, ஒரு property நல்ல investment ஆ இருக்குமா இல்லையா னு என்னால advise பண்ண முடியாது. நான் வெறும் inventory details மட்டும் தான் தர முடியும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent adheres to the business rule forbidding investment advice or predicting appreciation.

steps.purpose: Customer impatiently asks for a final yes or no on their budget.
steps.text: சரி, எனக்கு 3BHK தான் வேணும். வேற options list பண்ண time இல்ல. 60 lakhs கு கிடைக்குமா கிடைக்காதா?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms that no unit is available for the requested budget.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent clearly states that no matching unit exists for the given budget.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா புரியுது. ஆனா Hinjewadi project ல 60 lakhs budget கு எந்த 3BHK unit உம் available இல்ல.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent clearly states that no matching unit exists for the given budget, fulfilling the terminal condition.

steps.purpose: Customer abandons the goal and ends the call.
steps.text: சரி, அப்போ site visit ஒன்னும் வேணாம். நான் வேற developer கிட்ட பாக்குறேன். வெச்சிடுறேன்.
